result_text:
Any folder whose name starts with `mock` or `__mock` now counts as a mock-resources folder. I didn't write or run a test for the new patterns. The convention tests in `codeanalyzer` passed (`-Dtest='*Convention*'`), but nothing in the repo's tests mentions mock folders.

The change is in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/TestConventions.java`. The two path patterns had required at least one character from `[a-zA-Z0-9_\- ]` after `mock`. I replaced that with `[^/\\]*`:
- `.*/__mock[^/\\]*/.*`
- `.*/mock[^/\\]*/.*`

Taking the patterns as written, `mock/`, `mock.data/`, `mock(old)/`, `mock-größe/` and `mock模拟/` all match now. The old cases (`mocks/`, `__mocks__/`, `mock-data/`, `mock_data/`, `mock data/`, `mockStore/`) still match. `remock/` and `demo/` don't match, because the pattern needs a `/` right before `mock`. `src/main/java/` and files named `mock.java` or `mockery.java` don't match either, since they aren't folders starting with `mock`. Backslash paths are already handled by `SourceFileFilter.matches`, which tries a slash-normalised version of the path. The `[^/\\]*` part also stops the rest of the folder name from spilling into a deeper folder.
